cards: Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe
posted: Dr. E and Ponda Baba
shields_note: The post names no Defensive Shields.
notes: Starting cards as posted under Start (8): Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe, Executor: Holotheatre, Executor: Meditation Chamber, Visage, Prepared Defenses, Mobilization Points, Imperial Arrest Order & Secret Plans and No Escape; these count toward the 60.

Posted 'Hunt Down obj.' dested the printed (Special Edition) objective; 'Holotheatre' / 'Med. Chamber' dested Executor: Holotheatre / Executor: Meditation Chamber; 'Mob points' dested the Death Star II Effect Mobilization Points (the starting effect, not the You Cannot Hide Forever combo).
Posted '2xDarth Maul SA' dested Darth Maul, Young Apprentice (the strategy's 'new maul'); '1xDarth Maul' is the Tatooine Darth Maul.

Posted 'Death Star Dockin Bay' dested the Dark Death Star: Docking Bay 327 (the post says 'Death Star', not Death Star II); 'Executor Dockin Bay' dested Executor: Docking Bay; 'Rendli' dested Rendili; 'Imp holotable' dested Imperial Holotable; 'Flagship Bridge' dested Blockade Flagship: Bridge.

Posted 'Zuckas' (listed under Ships, used to stall space) dested Zuckuss In Mist Hunter; 'Mauls ship' dested Maul's Sith Infiltrator; 'maul Saber' / 'Vaders saber' dested Maul's Lightsaber / Vader's Lightsaber; 'Janus G.' dested Janus Greejatus; 'Thrawn' dested Grand Admiral Thrawn.

Posted 'Omni/its worse', 'Sniper Dark Strike', 'Masterful/Endor Occ' and 'IAO/secret plans' dested the Dark combo cards; 'Put all Sections' dested Put All Sections On Alert; 'Accelerate our plans' dested We Must Accelerate Our Plans.
Posted '1xhook' (under Effects) matches no Dark card and is printed as written (UNKNOWN).
The post's 'Changes' (Evader → Evader & Monnok, start Crush, P-60 for Rune Haako) were not applied to the list; the list is kept as published (60 cards).
